title: A mechanized algebra of tabular data handling: Lean 4 development
description: Lean 4 development behind the paper Split Safety for Tabular Data Handling: An Algebra and a Completeness Theorem. Tables are modeled as key-indexed multisets of rows. The thirteen modules of the library SplitAlgebra check every lemma, proposition and theorem of the paper: the classification of the operations as split invariant, union homomorphisms and split safe, the equational laws and inverse pairs, the rectangle facts, and the completeness theorems (strict fiber maps, reindex and gather maps, binary joins under aligned splits). The development contains no sorry and depends only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
